data.title: Magnitude 4.8 Earthquake Strikes Indonesia
data.content:
Jakarta, November 22, 2026, SPA -- A magnitude 4.8 earthquake struck the city of Sentani in Indonesia on Sunday.
    Indonesia's Meteorology, Climatology, and Geophysics Agency (BMKG) said in a statement that the earthquake occurred 35 kilometers northwest of Sentani at a depth of 6 kilometers. There were no immediate reports of casualties or material damage.
    -- SPA
19:50 Local Time 16:50 GMT
